newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes lower, pulled down by NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes lower, pulled down by NYMEX.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed lower on Friday, pulled down by a plunge in the NYMEX complex, especially unleaded gasoline, traders said.
June gas oil, which had a hit a high of $168.25 a tonne, closed $1.50 down at $164.25 a tonne, while July gas oil ended the day $2.00 lower at $165.75 a tonne.
"The market has been driven down by NYMEX. Gasoline now seems to have recovered slightly, but it was the real instigator there," one trader said.
"If we actually start to see more healthy rises in gasoline, we are certainly looking up for gas oil as well," the trader added.
NYMEX July unleaded gasoline was trading 0.92 cent a gallon down at 58.80 cents by 1648 GMT, a modest gain from the day's low of 58.65. NYMEX products were called to open 0.25 to 0.50 cent higher.
Meanwhile, IPE July Brent continued to trade in negative territory, standing at $18.11, or 21 cents below Thursday's close.
